title: MobaAbility Export Schema
description: Schema for exported MobaAbility resources in canonical JSON format

discipline.description: Combat discipline this ability belongs to

targeting_type.description: How the ability is targeted and delivered

aim_assist.description: Aim assist mode for this ability

aim_cone_degrees.description: Half-angle of the aim cone in degrees (used with SKILLSHOT / CHANNELED)

magnetism.description: Snap strength for soft-lock aim assist (0.0 = no snap, 1.0 = full snap)

acquisition_range.description: Radius in world units within which a target can be acquired

damage_type.description: Type of damage this ability deals

scaling.description: Scaling coefficients keyed by stat name (e.g. {"attack_damage": 0.6})

resource_cost.description: Resource cost to use this ability

channel_duration.description: Duration of the channel window for CHANNELED abilities

channel_tick_interval.description: Interval between ticks while channeling (seconds). 0 = continuous.

projectile_speed.description: Speed of projectiles in world units per second

duration.description: Duration of the ability's persistent effect, in seconds

charges.description: Number of charges this ability has

usable_in_air.description: Whether this ability can be used while airborne

touch_viable.description: Whether this ability can be executed with drag-to-aim

crowd_control.description: Optional crowd control applied by this ability

max_stacks.description: Maximum number of buff/debuff stacks this ability can apply

cancellable_by_movement.description: Whether movement can cancel this ability

cancellable_by_hard_cc.description: Whether hard crowd control can cancel this ability

refund_resource_on_cancel.description: Fraction of resource_cost returned on cancel (0.0 = none, 1.0 = full)

on_channel_break.description: What happens to effect delivery when a channel is broken

shield_amount.description: Self-shield capacity on cast (uses ability's duration field for shield duration)

affects_caster.description: Whether an AREA/GROUND ability includes the caster among its affected targets

target_allegiance.description: Which side an ability affects: hostile (enemies), friendly (allies), or any

targeting_collision_mask.description: Physics collision mask used by an AREA/GROUND ability's shape query

stat.description: The stat key this modifier applies to

amount.description: Flat or percentage amount to apply

duration.description: Duration in seconds. 0 means permanent until explicitly removed.

stacking.description: How multiple applications of this modifier interact

max_stacks.description: Maximum number of stacks allowed when stacking == STACK

type.description: The kind of crowd control applied

affected_by_tenacity.description: Whether the duration can be reduced by the target's Tenacity stat
